Tests understanding of PrivateLink per-tenant isolation basics and practical policy construction.

- VPC Endpoint Policies
- Security Groups for ENIs
- aws:SourceVpce condition
- Observability for cross-tenant access

```javascript
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "execute-api:Invoke",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:execute-api:us-east-1:123456789012:analytics-api-prod/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpce": "vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
